hero.title: Software Engineering Student & Full-Stack Developer
hero.intro: I build financial-grade software by day and study systems, distributed architecture, and cloud infrastructure by night. I care more about how software fails than how it demos.

about.title: How I approach engineering
about.paragraph1: I'm a software engineering student currently working as a Software Development Intern at Banco Central de Costa Rica, where I help migrate legacy financial systems that process information for more than 80 regulated institutions. That work sits at the intersection of correctness and scale — there's very little room for a query that's 'probably fine.'
about.paragraph2: What drives me is curiosity paired with an engineering mindset: I want to understand why a system behaves the way it does, not just make it pass tests. I'm comfortable across the stack — from React interfaces to ASP.NET services to the SQL Server queries underneath — but I'm especially drawn to backend development and cloud technologies, where the hardest and most interesting problems tend to live.
about.paragraph3: I treat AI-assisted development as a tool that raises the bar on review, not a shortcut around it: every generated line still has to earn its place through validation, testing, and quality gates like SonarQube. Long term, I'm aiming toward the intersection of technical impact, market demand, and durable growth — and right now that points toward backend, cloud, and full-stack engineering.
about.highlight2: Comfortable across frontend, backend, and databases
about.highlight3: Continuous learner, especially in cloud & systems design

bcr.role: Software Development Intern – Financial Information Systems
bcr.summary: Orchestrates AI agent-assisted system migrations within an Agile SDLC, reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs for accuracy, performance, and maintainability before integration testing and QA release.
bcr.bullet1: Reviews and validates C# code in financial systems processing high-volume data from 80+ banking and financial institutions, identifying SQL Server bottlenecks and improving query performance by up to 10%.
bcr.bullet2: Enforces code quality standards using SonarQube while actively participating in peer code reviews and knowledge sharing within a multidisciplinary SAFe Agile team.
bcr.bullet3: Supported system migrations using AI-assisted workflows, ensuring rigorous validation and testing before production release to maintain accuracy in mission-critical operations.
bcr.bullet4: Diagnosed architectural issues and documented solutions for legacy financial systems, contributing to technical knowledge base and process improvements.

ecommercePlatform.name: E-Commerce Platform
ecommercePlatform.tagline: A multi-role storefront built to handle real catalog and order complexity.
ecommercePlatform.overview: A full-stack e-commerce platform covering product catalog management, cart and checkout, order tracking, and an admin dashboard. Built to explore how a TypeScript backend and an Angular frontend stay in sync as a data model grows past a simple CRUD shape.
ecommercePlatform.feature1: Role-based access for customers, sellers, and administrators
ecommercePlatform.feature2: Product catalog with variants, categories, and search/filtering
ecommercePlatform.feature3: Cart and checkout flow with order status tracking
ecommercePlatform.feature4: Admin dashboard for inventory and order management
ecommercePlatform.challenge1: Modeling product variants (size, color, stock) without duplicating catalog logic across services
ecommercePlatform.challenge2: Keeping cart state consistent between client-side Angular state and the source of truth in MySQL
ecommercePlatform.challenge3: Designing indexes that kept catalog search fast as the product count grew
ecommercePlatform.architectureDescription: A Node.js/TypeScript REST API backed by MySQL, consumed by an Angular single-page frontend. Business logic is split into service layers so validation and persistence rules aren't duplicated between the catalog, cart, and order modules.

cruiseReservationSystem.name: Cruise Reservation System
cruiseReservationSystem.tagline: A reservation platform for managing cruise bookings end to end.
cruiseReservationSystem.overview: A reservation system for booking cruise cabins, managing itineraries, and handling passenger and payment records, built on ASP.NET and SQL Server as a deeper dive into transactional backend design.
cruiseReservationSystem.feature1: Cabin availability and booking flow with conflict prevention
cruiseReservationSystem.challenge1: Preventing double-booking of cabins under concurrent requests
cruiseReservationSystem.challenge2: Designing a schema that cleanly separates itineraries, sailings, and individual bookings
cruiseReservationSystem.challenge3: Keeping reservation state transitions (pending, confirmed, cancelled) consistent and auditable
cruiseReservationSystem.architectureDescription: An ASP.NET Web API following a layered architecture (controllers, services, repositories) on top of SQL Server, with transactions guarding booking-critical operations against race conditions.
